title: Rice/Paddy — Irrigation Scheduling and Water Management
content:
IRRIGATION FOR PADDY:

CRITICAL IRRIGATION STAGES:
1. Transplanting: 2-3 cm standing water for establishment.
2. Active tillering (15-25 DAT): 2-5 cm standing water.
3. Panicle initiation (45-55 DAT): Maintain 5 cm standing water — critical.
4. Flowering (65-70 DAT): 2-3 cm standing water — most critical stage.
5. Grain filling (70-85 DAT): 2-3 cm standing water.
6. Maturity: Drain field 10-15 days before harvest.

SATURATED SOIL CONDITION (SSC):
- Maintain 2.5 cm standing water at all times.
- Traditional method — uses more water.

ALTERNATE WETTING AND DRYING (AWD) — Recommended:
- Irrigate to 5 cm standing water.
- Allow to dry until soil cracks 6-8mm (15 cm pipe water level: 15 cm below surface).
- Re-irrigate to 5 cm.
- AWD saves 25-30% water with no yield loss.
- Not recommended during flowering — maintain continuous flooding.

TOTAL WATER REQUIREMENT: 900-1200 mm over crop duration.

DRAINAGE:
- Drain field at 2-3 days before transplanting (for puddling).
- Drain at panicle initiation for 3 days (mid-season drainage) — improves root health.
- Final drainage: 10-15 days before harvest for field access.

WATERLOGGING IN KHARIF:
- Excess rain causes anaerobic conditions — drain immediately.
- BR varieties (submergence tolerant) for flood-prone areas.

RAINFED PADDY MANAGEMENT:
- Use SRI method to optimize with available water.
- Maintain standing water only at critical stages.
